assets.statement: dyadic block Sidon construction fails hidden-subsequence attack: explicit witness N=2^(2k+3)-1 in inter-block gap gives |A∩[1,N]|/sqrt(N)≈sqrt(E_k/N)->0 along infinitely many N, violating "for all sufficiently large N"; naive repair (cross-scale Sidon superposition with density floor) is equivalent-

Regular n-gon is a counterexample: d(k)^2=4sin^2(pi k/n) gives at most 2 vertices on every circle centred at any vertex with any radius r>0 (premise holds, machine-checked n in [3,360] fail-closed), and exactly floor(n/2) distinct distances, which is less than (1+c)n/2 for every c>0 and all n>=3.

All-primes choice makes the a_k sequence finite, violating the canonical premise; vacuous-goodness argument is domain drift, needs an infinite survivor construction plus literal quantifier-order verification.

explicit 4-periodic walk over S={e1,e2} satisfies all frozen premises yet its four-point image (unit square vertices) has no three collinear points; canonical statement is false as frozen and must be re-frozen with an injectivity/unboundedness premise before either branch can close nontrivially

Zero-step degenerate walk (S∋0, constant walk, singleton A) satisfies all stated premises and violates the conclusion; statement needs 0∉S and infinitely many distinct points before the real conjecture is engaged.

refuted by explicit divergence: min-colouring is an infinite affirmative witness for m≤κ but a finite counterexample in every tested finite instance, so finite-to-infinite transfer fails and no close is computable.
